items.question: Under the UAE visit or tourist entry permit/visa, is the holder allowed to work in the UAE?
items.gold: No, a visit or tourist entry permit does not give the right to work in the UAE.
items.fact: Visit or tourist entry permit does not allow working in UAE

items.question: Under the UAE Labour Law, who is responsible for paying recruitment expenses when a worker is hired for a job in the UAE?
items.gold: The employer is responsible for payment of recruitment expenses.
items.fact: Employer pays recruitment expenses under UAE Labour Law
